name: Ganesh Tok
town_description: Ganesh Tok sits at 6,500 ft (~1,980 m) on a hillock off the Gangtok-Nathula road (NH-310, Chandmari), 7 km from Gangtok town, in Gangtok district. It offers panoramic views of Gangtok town, Raj Bhawan and - on clear mornings - the Kanchenjunga massif. The spot is a standard stop on Gangtok sightseeing circuits, often combined with Hanuman Tok and Tashi View Point.

travel.road: About 7 km from Gangtok on the Gangtok-Nathula road; reachable by taxi; standard local sightseeing stop (verify).

visitor_information.best_time: October to April, early morning for the clearest Kanchenjunga views; the seasonal cafeteria operates in tourist months.
